authorization: 迭代一下，更新为新的游戏默认画风
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create one complete redraw of IMAGE 2 in the actual hand-painted illustration style of IMAGE 1. IMAGE 1 is the master reference for brush shapes, edge variation, texture density and lighting, not merely palette. IMAGE 2 controls character identity and overall framing only. Single finished wide 16:9 painting.
Preserve the white/silver-haired woman at the right edge leaning toward the viewer, cyan eyes, blue bow, round sunglasses on her forehead, black rose hair ornament, long hair and gathered crown hairstyle, small playful smile, black ruffled outfit and strap. Preserve her scale and crop and the central one-point winter road composition with snowy fields and roadside metal guardrails.
Reconstruct the environment from scratch with the irregular, selective painting of IMAGE 1. Near snow: large interlocking broken blue-gray and off-white shapes, unequal wedges and occasional soft merging edges, snow lying in ragged flattened banks around grass and posts. Vary shape, spacing and contrast; avoid strings of white rounded balls. Guardrails: weighty muted dark teal-gray faces, a few broad broken scraped color strokes, intermittent reflections, edges locally hidden by snow and shadow. Avoid continuous bright stripes, ruler-clean outlines and evenly spaced sharp detail.
Distant landscape: low quiet masses in blue-gray haze, tree and grass shapes partially merge into adjacent snow; irregular loose small dabs only where useful, avoid a row of distinct houses/trees or evenly planted grass. Leave broad quiet areas. Sky like reference: spacious softly layered desaturated blue cloud masses with subtle value transitions, faint dusty rose light diffused close to the horizon, no sharp orange sunset ribbon or speckled scalloped cloud ceiling.
Road like IMAGE 1: continuous damp dark blue asphalt with gently blurred broad reflections and intermittent transparent pale peach strokes. Fine grain is irregular, varied in size and clustered in selected foreground areas, disappearing through reflections and with distance; leave calm connected midtone passages. No evenly distributed circular stone texture, crack network or sharp outlined puddles. Reflections should be asymmetrical and broken with a very faint pink warmth, not multiple symmetrical glowing orange lanes.
Character: delicate colored anime linework integrated into matte painted shapes, clear expressive eyes, subtle cheek hatching and cool-warm skin variation, restrained cast shadows; broad organized hair masses with limited selected strand accents, not a dense net of fine outlines. Cool blue-gray ambient shadow with occasional very soft warm edge accents, do not draw an unbroken peach outline around the hair.
Match reference's subdued uneven luminance, handmade edges and clear hierarchy of detail: articulated foreground transitions, calmer midground, merging distant edges. Keep subject readable and atmosphere quiet and intimate. Do not globally blur or apply an all-over texture filter. Do not import reference character's hat, braid, halo, clothing or identity. No text, UI or watermark.
